title: How to plan African payment method coverage
description: Use this recipe to plan a merchant rollout that combines cards, mobile money, and fallback processing for African markets.
prerequisites: A target launch country or region.
An IXOPAY connector strategy for card and alternative payment methods.
A fallback plan for redirects, delayed confirmations, and callback retries.

steps.title: Group payment methods by market fit
steps.body: Start with market and device context. Mobile-money-first regions should not use the same checkout ordering as card-first regions.

steps.title: Keep fallback logic explicit
steps.body: Use IXOPAY orchestration to model fallback and retry behavior intentionally. Merchants should know when they are using a primary method, a fallback PSP, or a delayed confirmation flow.

steps.title: Document launch and receipt behavior
steps.body: For each market, document what customers see at checkout, what happens on pending confirmation, and what appears on the receipt.

validation: Each market has an explicit payment method order.
Fallback behavior is documented for support teams.
Receipt and pending-result templates match the selected method mix.
